paragraphs: Rav Katina. ‘Rav Katina said’: Ta'anit 7b; Yoma 54a; Hullin 28b; Menahot 97a. ‘Anyone who mocks has his sustenance diminished’: Avodah Zarah 18b. Nazir; Rav Hisda said that Rav Katina said: Bekhorot 35a–b; Arakhin 32a; Bava Metzia 79a. Rav Mordekhai said to Rava, ‘Rav Katina raises a conclusive objection’: Shabbat 50, end of b. Rabbah bar Rav Huna said that Rav Katina said: Bekhorot 44b. An angel encountered Rav Katina wearing a linen wrap and told him, ‘Katina, Katina, a linen wrap in summer,’ etc.; Menahot 41a. Yuhasin writes that it was R' Zeira, who was called Katina, who did this. In my view he erred (see there). At the beginning of Rosh Hashanah chapter 4, 31a, Rav Katina said: ‘One [millennium] desolate.’ It appears that Rav Katina preceded R' Zeira, for Rav Hisda said that Rav Katina said, and R' Zeira said that Rav Hisda said.
